notes: «قالا حدثنا شعبة، عن الحكم، قال سمعت ابن أبي ليلى، قال لقيني كعب بن عجرة» : the names after شعبة are written once, so they are the shared tail for both branches.
The first branch («ح») and the second («قالا») both end at شعبة, written in each branch as the text does.
Ka'b is the last link: he relays the Prophet's words.
